Bug_Title: Unnecessary equality checks should not be made
Bug_Explanation: The code demonstrates unnecessary equality checks between unrelated classes, class and interface, interfaces, array and non-array, and incompatible arrays. These comparisons will always return false, and the comparison and dependent code can be removed.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case creates instances of the classes Spatula, Tree, KitchenTool, and Plant, and then calls the showBug() method which compares these instances using the equals() method. The test should fail when the showBug() method makes comparisons between dissimilar types or arrays.
